name: TOB User Activity Event
description: One row per curated in-app event (see truth_of_bible/analytics/activity.py's _ALLOWED_EVENTS) — the real per-user activity log behind the admin 'who did what' report, deliberately separate from Firebase/GA4 (aggregate-only, no per-user drill-down or avatars in-app). Written in small batches by record_batch(), never one row per client HTTP request — track_changes is off since this is high-volume log data, not a document anyone edits.

fields.label: Event
fields.description: One of _ALLOWED_EVENTS in truth_of_bible/analytics/activity.py — Data, not Select, so a new event can be added client-side without a schema migration.

fields.label: Event Time
fields.description: The client-side time the event actually happened, not when the batch was uploaded — batches can be flushed several minutes (or an app-background) after the fact.

fields.label: Data (JSON)
fields.description: Event-specific parameters as a JSON object, e.g. {"book": "John", "chapter": 3} for verse_opened — shape varies per event, same JSON-in-Long-Text precedent as TOB Social Post.platforms.
